description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. As a Principal Talent Acquisition Partner for GTM, you will lead hiring for Enterprise Sales and Solutions, including international hiring. This is a strategic, influential role. You will advise senior GTM leaders on talent strategy and market insight, build and run high-performing pipelines, and help raise the capability of the wider TA team. You will manage the full recruitment lifecycle with rigor, navigate ambiguity as the business grows, and use data to shape recruiting strategy.

 

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Own hiring delivery for Enterprise Sales and Solutions, including internationally, with consistent urgency and quality from sourcing through offer negotiation.
  • Run a rigorous approach to pipeline management and to accuracy in Greenhouse and other systems, and hold yourself accountable for pipeline gaps, progress and trends.
  • Build trusted relationships with GTM leaders at the Director and VP level, advising them on best practices, including coaching hiring managers on structured interviewing and evidence-based assessment frameworks.
  • Recruit bespoke IC and manager-level roles across backfill or net-new position types, and build scalable, documented, equitable processes where none exist.
  • Conduct thorough due diligence prior to kicking off any new requisition to ensure a deep understanding of the hiring manager's line of business and role requirements.
  • Spend time every week on proactive sourcing and passive candidate engagement, so you are building toward future hiring and not only today's reqs.
  • Use data and analytics to find trends, tune sourcing and influence talent decisions, and report progress to stakeholders and TA leaders against seated headcount goals.
  • Improve the experience of candidates and hiring teams, balancing speed, quality and inclusivity.
  • Champion new TA processes and tools, including AI tools such as BrightHire and Claude, and lead the team in adopting them.
  • Train, mentor and onboard others, including new contractors and junior partners, and help run enablement sessions.
  • Flex and support other roles across Toast hiring as business needs evolve, demonstrating the agility to pivot, take ownership, and proactively seek clarity during ambiguous situations.

 

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 10+ years of recruitment experience in GTM (Sales, Customer Success, G&A) Talent Acquisition, with a record of recruiting across multiple functions and business units.
  • Strong leadership experience, with a history of mentoring, coaching, and enabling teams to deliver.
  • Demonstrated success giving strategic guidance to senior leaders.
  • Deep experience using data analytics to drive recruiting strategy and performance.
  • Expertise with recruiting analytics tools, data visualization platforms and HRIS systems.
  • Ability to influence and drive change in a matrixed, cross-functional environment.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills, including explaining complex data clearly.
  • Proven ability to work in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, with strong problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset.

 

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)

  • Proven experience partnering closely with or embedded within Recruitment Operations to optimize TA processes, tools, and workflows.
  • Demonstrated success leading strategic TA projects and programs from inception to execution, using structured frameworks such as RACI to drive alignment and delivery.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI and automation tools to optimize workflows and boost individual or team productivity.

 

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.


Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.
